svg.title: Navigation routine execution sequence
svg.desc: Six-step sequence executed by Timer1 interrupt at 200 Hz, showing velocity calculation, speed computation, PID control, motor actuation, sensor reading, and servo angle setting.
svg.text: NavRoutine() Execution at 200 Hz (5 ms cycle)

g.text: Frequency: 200 Hz | Period: 5 ms | CPU overhead: ~10%
